name: Meridional rank conjecture for 243 of the 536 thirteen-crossing knots with bridge index [3,4] (partial result)
target: b(K) = mu(K) = 4 for the knots K with 13 crossings that KnotInfo 2026.10.5 lists with bridge index [3,4]
result: Proved for 243 knots by a Wirtinger-4 diagram and a representation sending meridians to transvections of Sp(4,3), Sp(4,5) or reflections of O(4,5) with no common fixed vector; the other 293 stay open.

notes.formal: no Lean; every certificate is checked by verify/verify.py in the repository and again by construct/transvections.py here
